title: Building a Roblox tycoon with ChatGPT/Codex: the useful part was revising the first minute
author: BladesRed
selftext:
Sharing the development process behind Gadget Impire Tycoon, a Roblox workshop/business game made with ChatGPT and Codex assistance. This is a project showcase and self-promotion.



The workflow was iterative: describe a feature, have the assistant change the Lua scripts and UI, then check the result in Roblox Studio. Adding more features quickly exposed a problem: the join screen became crowded and the introduction delayed actually playing. A later pass shortened the intro from roughly 34 seconds to an eight-second skippable workshop tour, moved secondary controls into a compact menu, and added a four-step first-shift guide. That was a more useful change than just adding another feature.



Economy requests also needed precise wording. “Harder to spend money” became two separate tasks: purchase confirmation to reduce accidental spending, and progression costs that stay meaningful as income rises. Cash-pack rewards were designed to grow with milestones while keeping their Robux price fixed. These were decisions and revisions, rather than a single prompt producing a finished game.



The resulting game lets players build and sell electronics, hire staff, and expand workshops. It has shared-company play, free private servers, and a peaceful campus without stealing. The landing-page hero is AI-generated promotional artwork, not a gameplay screenshot.



Project overview: [https://gadget-impire-tycoon.colds.chatgpt.site](https://gadget-impire-tycoon.colds.chatgpt.site)

Play: [https://www.roblox.com/games/106131728316282/Gadget-Impire-Tycoon](https://www.roblox.com/games/106131728316282/Gadget-Impire-Tycoon)



Roblox and an eligible account are required. The game is currently listed for ages 16+ and has optional Robux purchases.
